messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Social conditions and indicators and Youth in Germany during the 1980s, matching this research need: Survey data on adults in West Germany covering moral values, life experiences, memories of the 1950s and postwar period, parenting, youth-group affiliation, religion, and political attitudes with detailed demographic variables.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: dataset West Germany survey 1980s memories 1950s postwar parenting youth groups moral values religion political attitudes
GESIS 1980s West Germany survey youth group membership memories postwar 1950s values parenting
action.query: dataset West Germany survey 1980s memories 1950s postwar parenting youth groups moral values religion political attitudes

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) 1982 (ZA1160)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1160","justification":"Strong match for survey research on social conditions, moral values, family relationships, parenting, religion, and political attitudes among adults in West Germany. Conducted from February to May 1982, the survey covers attitudes toward marriage and family, desired characteristics of children, educational goals, religious beliefs and practices, political orientations, and the importance of different aspects of life. Includes detailed demographic characteristics. Particularly relevant for examining intergenerational values and social change during the 1980s, although retrospective memories of the 1950s are not its primary focus."},{"title":"German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) – Cumulation 1980–2014 (ZA4584)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA4584","justification":"Highly relevant longitudinally comparable collection of repeated cross-sectional surveys of German adults. The 1980–1988 waves cover West Germany and West Berlin, providing information on social values, family structures, religious affiliation, political attitudes, social participation, and socioeconomic characteristics. Useful for identifying changes in moral orientations, parenting attitudes, and social conditions throughout the 1980s. Its detailed demographic variables support comparisons between generations, including adults who experienced the postwar period."},{"title":"German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) – Cumulation 1980–2008","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.11000","justification":"Relevant harmonized survey dataset containing West German adult respondents from 1980, 1982, 1984, 1986, and 1988. Covers religious values, marriage and family life, political behavior, social attitudes, and demographic characteristics. Especially useful for comparing adults from different birth cohorts and investigating how experiences of postwar Germany may relate to values and political orientations in the 1980s. Retrospective questions about the 1950s and youth-group membership would need to be verified at the variable level."},{"title":"World Values Surveys and European Values Surveys, 1981–1984, 1990–1993, and 1995–1997","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.3886/ICPSR02790","justification":"Strong thematic match for moral values, religion, parenting, family relationships, political beliefs, and social attitudes. Includes survey data from the early 1980s, allowing examination of West German adults' views on morality, child-rearing, marriage, religious practices, political participation, and social institutions. Detailed demographic variables include age, sex, occupation, household composition, income, and geographic characteristics. Particularly useful for studying generational differences in values, although detailed memories of the 1950s and historical youth-group affiliation are not central components."},{"title":"DJI Youth Survey 1992 and 1997 – Cumulated Dataset (ZA3608)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.3608","justification":"Supplementary dataset examining moral orientations, social conditions, political attitudes, identity, family relationships, and youth experiences in Germany. Includes questions about life satisfaction, discussions with parents, political values, social belonging, and demographic characteristics. Useful for comparing the attitudes of younger generations with those of adults surveyed during the 1980s. However, data collection occurred in 1992 and 1997, making this a secondary rather than direct match for research focused on West Germany during the 1980s."}]}
